assumptions.choice: Higher timeframes (2h/1h/30m) are synthesized from the single 15m feed using fixed tumbling windows counted from the start of data (bar_index // N), not calendar/session-aligned resampling.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only one bt.PandasData feed (15m); the strategy has no access to cerebro to add resampled/replayed data feeds, so true calendar-aligned multi-timeframe resampling is unavailable. Tumbling windows of 8/4/2/1 base bars are the closest literal construction of 2h/1h/30m/15m candles from the given feed.

assumptions.choice: The 'specific 2-hour candle's period' confinement is read as the current higher-timeframe candle's bar range; within that range, lower-timeframe pattern completions are counted using the immediately preceding lower-tf candle as context (which may fall just before the window). The count for the top timeframe is always 1 (a single confirmed instance). Drill-down continues only while each lower timeframe's count is strictly greater than the timeframe above it, all the way to 15m.
assumptions.reason: Because every timeframe in the default set is exactly 2x the next lower one, a higher-tf candle contains only 2 lower-tf sub-candles, so a strict same-window-only comparison could never exceed a count of 1 vs 1. Allowing the boundary-crossing prior candle as pattern context (standard TA practice) makes 'finds a greater number of instances on the immediately lower timeframe' achievable and internally consistent, matching the spec's intent of recursively finding higher concentration on lower timeframes.

assumptions.choice: Entry is submitted as a market buy at the close of the bar on which the full 2h->1h->30m->15m drill-down is confirmed (i.e., the bar completing the 2-hour window), rather than at the close of whichever specific 15m candle inside the window last completed the pattern.
assumptions.reason: The full recursive signal can only be causally confirmed once the 2-hour window closes; any earlier in-window 15m pattern instance has already passed by that point, so a non-look-ahead reference implementation must act at window completion.
The spec names ATR of the entry timeframe but never states a lookback period.

assumptions.choice: 'Total Capital' in the position-sizing formula is read as the current broker portfolio value (self.broker.getvalue()) at the moment of the entry signal.
assumptions.reason: The spec does not specify whether this is fixed starting cash or current equity; current equity is the more common reading for a 'risk per trade' formula that should scale with account performance.

assumptions.choice: The ATR value used to compute both the position size and the take-profit/stop-loss levels is captured once at the entry signal bar and held fixed for that trade (not recalculated on later bars).
assumptions.reason: The spec ties position size directly to '0.5x ATR' stop distance; using a single consistent ATR snapshot keeps the realized stop distance and the sizing formula in agreement for the life of the trade.

assumptions.choice: Implemented via a `printlog` parameter (default False) that, when enabled, prints the cumulative per-timeframe instance-count dictionary as the drill-down proceeds.
assumptions.reason: The spec requires the strategy be 'able to' output counts for logging/analysis but does not mandate it always print; defaulting off keeps output clean while the capability is present.

assumptions.choice: Only Bullish/Bearish Engulfing (the spec's stated default) are implemented, as dedicated, swappable methods (_bullish_engulfing/_bearish_engulfing) rather than a full library of candlestick patterns.
assumptions.reason: The spec asks that the pattern be 'easily replaceable', a structural requirement, not that additional pattern types be implemented; adding unrequested patterns would exceed the specification.
